hero.subtitle: FinCoach is your AI finance coach — portfolio, budget, funds, and goals, all explained in plain language by seven specialist agents.
hero.microcopy: No card needed · Sample data included · Yours in seconds

card.coachQuestion: How is my portfolio doing this month?
card.coachAnswer: You're up 12.4% — driven mostly by tech. Want me to rebalance toward your risk target?

trust.label: Real data, from sources you can check

features.title: One app for your whole financial life
features.subtitle: From the daily budget to the long-term plan — FinCoach connects the pieces and explains the why.

items.title: AI Coach
items.desc: Ask anything about your money. Specialist agents research markets, funds, and your portfolio, then answer with sources you can verify.

items.title: Portfolio tracking
items.desc: Follow stocks and crypto with live prices, performance charts, and instant, plain-language insights.

items.title: Smart budgeting
items.desc: See exactly where your money goes — categorized transactions, subscriptions, and accounts in ₺, $, or €.

items.title: Fund analysis
items.desc: Research and compare Turkish funds (TEFAS) side by side, without ever leaving the app.

items.title: Goal planning
items.desc: Set financial goals and watch progress with clear milestones and honest projections.

items.title: Document import
items.desc: Drop in a PDF statement and FinCoach turns it into clean, categorized transactions automatically.

how.title: From data to decisions in three steps
how.subtitle: No spreadsheets, no jargon. Just answers you can act on.

steps.title: Add your data
steps.desc: Import a statement, add your holdings, or start instantly with sample data. Setup takes seconds.

steps.title: Ask your coach
steps.desc: Chat in plain language. Every answer is backed by real market data and linked citations.

steps.title: Reach your goals
steps.desc: Track budgets, grow your portfolio, and hit milestones with guidance at every step.

rows.title: Answers you can actually trust
rows.desc: FinCoach never hand-waves. Every market claim comes with a citation, so you can check the source and decide for yourself.

rows.title: From PDF to insight in seconds
rows.desc: Upload a bank or brokerage statement and watch it become clean, categorized transactions — no manual entry, no copy-paste.
